widgets_values:
CURRENT LATENT-MASKED MULTI-CLIP AV EXTENSION

Use GLOBAL START MODE to choose either an uploaded source video or a newly generated T2V/I2V starter clip. Then generate 1–6 sequential H3 extensions.

Optional global reference images can preserve subject identity/appearance across extension clips.

PERSISTENT REGENERATION CACHE
- Every starter/extension CHECKPOINT is a lazy disk-backed generation gate.
- On Queue it compares the current generation graph signature with metadata saved inside that checkpoint.
- Exact match: sampler is not requested; the saved checkpoint is reused even if Comfy evicted RAM cache.
- Change Extension N seed/prompt: N and later dependent extensions regenerate; unchanged earlier extensions stay saved.

Final assembly is streamed one checkpoint at a time with linear visual blending at every seam. No cumulative full-movie IMAGE tensor is built.

EXTENSION COUNT / OPTIONAL GROUPS
- Default: only Extension 1 is active.
- Use OPTIONAL EXTENSIONS 2–6 — ENABLE SEQUENTIALLY to turn on later extension groups.
- Set GLOBAL ACTIVE EXTENSION COUNT to the highest enabled Extension number.

READ ME — VIDEO START OR T2V/I2V START
widgets_values:
ONE GLOBAL START MODE — CHOOSE ONCE:

start with T2V/I2V
- The SOURCE VIDEO group is automatically bypassed, so VHS_LoadVideo is not submitted or validated.
- STARTER FIRST FRAME OFF = T2V.
- STARTER FIRST FRAME ON + Load Image = I2V.

Start from existing video
- The SOURCE VIDEO group is automatically enabled.
- Load the source video normally; its frames/audio become the beginning of the movie.

There is no second source-mode switch to keep synchronized. GLOBAL START MODE also feeds the H3 context, canvas selector, and final checkpoint assembler internally.

STARTER — T2V / I2V SOURCE CLIP
widgets_values:
integrated_multimodal_description:
Create the opening clip for a new continuous video. If a first_frame image is connected, treat it as the starting frame and animate naturally forward while preserving that subject and composition. If no first_frame is connected, generate the opening clip from text alone. Establish a coherent subject, camera, lighting, environment, motion, and audiovisual timing so later masked extensions can continue seamlessly.

overall_soundscape:
Establish the opening ambience, voice, and sound design for the new scene.

non_diegetic_music:
Add music only if desired; otherwise leave absent.
